original_test_intent: Stress all DIMMs in the required 1DPC population for 12 hours at 0C/+5% rails and detect memory or system instability.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Install 1DPC DIMMs, boot the OS, select SST memory stress, and run 12 hours.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: No SST/BMC event errors, hang, or blue screen.

historical_reviews.v3: IMPROVED MANUAL ONLY with population and CE/UE requirements; treated 240-minute Machine Time as SOURCE_CONFLICT.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Qualified staff establish DIMM population and environmental margin; SST execution and telemetry may be automated.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: 1DPC all-DIMM population, 0C/+5% rails, 12-hour SST memory stress; Machine Time is planning.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Slot/serial population, memory range/profile, CE/UE limits, condensation controls and approved override.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Any slot, memory-range or duration reduction must be enumerated.

original_method: Original 1DPC SST memory-stress method is retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the qualified project memory-stress profile with SMBIOS/EDAC correlation and per-slot baseline.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact CPU memory topology and DIMM population.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform memory-population guide and SST/tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds measured address-range coverage and error telemetry; does not replace SST.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: All populated channels and intended memory ranges remain required.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Population map, stress fraction/range and CE/UE policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Low-temperature condensation and rail margin require lab controls.

safety_boundaries: No reduced memory range or log clearing
expected_evidence: SST settings and measured memory coverage
no_automatic_retry: Memory errors remain in the original run record.
review_improvement: Removes the planning-time false conflict while preserving 12-hour, all-DIMM and environmental coverage.
